name: cisco_xdr_api_call
description: Call the Cisco XDR (Extended Detection & Response) REST API. Host is auto-selected from the path prefix (/iroh/* Platform, /ctia/* Private Intel, /v2/* Conure incidents, /api/v1/* Automate); all share one OAuth2 token. Blast radius: GET=low, POST/PUT/PATCH=medium, DELETE=destructive (metadata only, never blocks).

function.name: cisco_xdr_api_call
function.description:
Call the Cisco XDR (Extended Detection & Response) REST API. ONE tool; host + auth resolved automatically. Supply only method + path (+ body/query). Returns {status_code,data,error,blast_radius}; check status_code < 400.

Cisco XDR is a THREAT-INTELLIGENCE & response platform — NOT an endpoint/host inventory. There is NO /v1/computers, /v1/hosts or device list.

The path PREFIX selects the host (all share one OAuth2 token):
  /iroh/*    -> Platform (enrich, inspect, respond)
  /ctia/*    -> Private Intel (threat-intel store: incidents, indicators, sightings, judgements, verdicts, investigations, ...)
  /v2/*      -> Conure (incident search/count)
  /api/v1/*  -> Automate (automation workflows)

OBSERVABLES = ARRAY of {"type":"domain|ip|ipv6|url|sha256|sha1|md5|email|file_name","value":".."}.

KEY PATHS:
  POST /iroh/iroh-inspect/inspect               Extract observables from text; body {"content":".."}
  POST /iroh/iroh-enrich/observe/observables    Deep enrichment -> verdicts/judgements/sightings; body [observables]
  POST /iroh/iroh-enrich/deliberate/observables Quick verdicts; body [observables]
  POST /iroh/iroh-enrich/refer/observables      Pivot/reference links; body [observables]
  POST /iroh/iroh-response/respond/observables  Available response actions; body [observables]
  GET  /ctia/{type}/search                      Search threat-intel; REQUIRED query_params {"query":"*","limit":50}; {type}=incident|indicator|sighting|judgement|verdict|investigation|...
  GET  /ctia/{type}/search/count                Count; query_params {"query":"*"}
  GET  /ctia/{type}/{id}                          Get one by id; GET /ctia/incident/{id}/summary for incident summary
  GET  /v2/incident/search                       Search incidents (Conure mirror); REQUIRED query_params {"query":"*","limit":50}
  GET  /v2/incident/search/count                Count incidents (Conure); query_params {"query":"*"}
  GET  /api/v1/workflows                        List automation workflows

NOTES: searching ALWAYS uses /search with a REQUIRED {"query":"*"} param; a bare /v2/incident or /ctia/incident is a 405. A 401 means credentials are wrong (Settings -> Cisco XDR). An empty [] or 0 with status 200 is a valid empty result, not a failure.

path.description: API endpoint path; the prefix selects the host (e.g., '/iroh/iroh-enrich/observe/observables')

body.description: Request body for POST/PUT/PATCH (optional). Observable payloads are a JSON array.

query_params.description: URL query parameters as key-value pairs (optional, e.g. {"limit": 100})
